objective: Keep immutable historical reward notifications while preventing obsolete level-curve numbers from being presented as current player truth in notification cards or celebration overlays.

roles_before.artifact: Historical notification.pushed events are immutable ledger history and may contain values derived under an older level policy.
Live profile projection owns the current Level/XP-to-next state under system-level-xp:v2.
Notification cards and celebration overlays currently render old reward body text verbatim, so the unread pre-v2 reward still says 480 XP to Level 2 while current state says 80 XP.
Neon/PostgreSQL remains the sole mutable owner; stale copy must be corrected at projection time, not by rewriting history.
Git history is sufficient; no state migration or notification acknowledgement is required.

role_dispositions.destination: Raw historical title/body/event remain unchanged in Neon and logs.
Current profile level/xp_to_next remains authoritative for present-tense progression.
A pure player-view helper detects reward progression text that conflicts with current profile and appends an explicit current-state correction while preserving the historical reward fact.
No action endpoint call, event write, acknowledgement, deletion or backfill.

capability_probes.assertion: The current unread +10 XP reward may retain its historical 480-XP text in the ledger, but player cards/celebration state that current Level-2 distance is 80 XP and that 480 belongs to the prior scale.
A reward notification whose displayed next-level distance still matches current profile is rendered unchanged.
If a historical reward references a level threshold already passed, the player view marks it historical and reports the current level/next threshold instead of treating the old number as current.
Quest/system/deadline notifications without reward progression text are unchanged by this helper.
No ledger notification body is rewritten and no unread item is acknowledged automatically.

tests.expected: notification cards and celebrations consume the projected player copy.

verification.base_head_diff: Adds a pure notification player-view projection that preserves immutable reward history but detects obsolete next-level numbers against the live profile and appends an explicit current-state correction. Notification cards and celebration overlays consume the projected copy; no acknowledgement, deletion, action endpoint call, ledger mutation, reward math or level policy change.
verification.candidate_readback: Cloud #834 passed model tests, PostgreSQL action-gate + anonymous HTTP smoke and Docker smoke; continuity #2237 passed; PWA #488 passed after app/player utility/cache contract changes. Base-to-head review found only the declared projection/UI/test/manifest slice.
